title: Bank / Card Alert

messages.text: A transaction alert was generated on your corporate card. If this wasn't you, report it via the Finance Portal.
Security check: Your corporate card is temporarily restricted. Restore access: https://nexatrust-securecard.com/login

explainPoints: Fake restriction claim: SMS B falsely states the card is 'temporarily restricted'. SMS A simply alerts about a transaction.
Fake link (nexatrust-securecard.com): SMS B contains a scam domain for 'restoring access'. SMS A directs to the legitimate Finance Portal.
Level of urgency: SMS B creates panic with 'Security check' and demands immediate action. SMS A is calm and informational, offering optional reporting.
